scene: The funicular drops you at Grand Transit Plaza.
picture: Side-scrolling view of a bustling lower transit plaza. On the far left, a red-canopied rickshaw waits beside a friendly driver. The player in his blue flat cap and orange cardigan stands left of centre with his cane. In the centre, a water taxi floats tied to a low dock. Far right, an elevated monorail platform door stands open.
shown: a wheeled rickshaw with a waiting puller on the far left
a turquoise water taxi tied to the stone canal dock centre
a gleaming monorail car waiting at an open platform far right
